reason: My bookkeeper already runs everything through Zoho Expense and it works well enough. I'm not moving my site receipts into a Google Sheet run by a Telegram bot just to skip a bit of typing.
objection: This is a small bot with an @ handle. If it shuts down in six months, my expense history is half in a sheet and half in Zoho, and my bookkeeper has to clean it up.
would_change_my_mind: If it pushed the receipts straight into Zoho or Jurnal instead of a separate sheet, so my bookkeeper keeps her setup and I only use it to grab receipts from the Telegram groups.
